run_doctest_implicit: run the doctest suite that validates Boost.Python implicit conversion between X objects and integers
test_x_value_function: test the x_value function that extracts an integer value from an X object or plain int
test_make_x_function: test the make_x function that constructs an X object from an integer or X instance
test_x_value_method: test the X.value method that returns the integer value stored in an X instance
test_x_set_method: test the X.set method that assigns a new value to an X instance
